$comment_do_not_generate_from_repo: This fixture MUST NOT be produced by reading data/releases/products/*.json. Every 'official_release_date' below was transcribed from Konami's own official Yu-Gi-Oh! Neuron card database product/collection listing (a single, un-paginated, chronologically-sorted page enumerating every OCG product from today back to Vol.1) fetched directly on 2026-08-28, independently of and prior to reconciling against the repository's product JSON files. The repo product id in each row is only a foreign key so the comparison test knows what to check it against - it is never the source of the date value next to it. This file supersedes an earlier partial version (5 of 19 rows, evidence_type 'product' for 3 rows including both Game Guide discrepancies) authored during the same 2026-08 recertification by an independent research agent using the identical primary source and method; this version extends that agent's findings to full 19-row coverage from the same single fetch, which happens to cover every remaining row directly (no card-series reconstruction was needed).
purpose: Independent (non-repo-derived) evidence base for the ocg-jp 1999 pre-Tokyo-Dome release ledger, used ONLY to check the live repository's product dates against real external evidence. Covers all 19 products certified after the 2026-08 recertification, plus one deleted-product entry (negative evidence) for adversarial regression coverage.

primary_source.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Neuron official card game card database - 収録 ("Products/Collections") listing, sorted 公開日の新しい順 (newest release date first)
primary_source.notes:
A single server-rendered page (no pagination observed) enumerating every OCG product/distribution from the current date back to the OCG's first product, Vol.1 (1999/02/04) - confirmed by reading to the literal end of the DOM text content and finding Vol.1 as the last entry, immediately preceded by the 1999/02/21 National Tournament attendance-card row and nothing else in between. Each row is a
YYYY/MM/DD
+
【category】 fiscal-year-range
+

official product/distribution name (Japanese)

block. This is DIFFERENT from, and independent of, Yugipedia and the ignis-babelcdb import pipeline the repository's own products use as their primary sources - it is Konami's own product catalogue, not a wiki's transcription of it. Verified reproducible: fetched independently by two different research passes (an automated agent and a direct curl re-fetch) on the same day, byte-identical results for every 1999 row.

methodology:
The Konami product-list page was fetched directly (curl, User-Agent set, request_locale=ja) on 2026-08-28; every
1999/...
block and its immediately following category/name text were extracted verbatim. Every one of the ledger's 19 currently-certified ocg-jp products, plus the one deleted product, has a directly corresponding row on this single page - no card-level print-history reconstruction was needed for this fixture (evidence_type 'product' throughout). Extending this fixture for a NEW product means re-fetching this same page (or, if a product does not appear on it, falling back to card-level print-history reconstruction per the 'card-series' evidence type) - never copying data/releases/products/.json's own release_events into this file.

evidence_type_definitions.product: A single Konami-catalogue row (収録 entry) maps 1:1 onto this repo product - the strongest evidence tier used throughout this fixture.
evidence_type_definitions.card-series: No single dedicated product-level Konami row exists; the date would be reconstructed from that product's individual cards' own printing-history entries in Konami's card-level database instead (not needed for any row in this fixture's current 19-product coverage).
evidence_type_definitions.secondary: No direct official Konami evidence (product-level or card-level) exists; the date is carried over from a secondary aggregator (e.g. Yugipedia) with that aggregator's own reliability caveats attached in 'notes'.
evidence_type_definitions.negative: Konami's official product catalogue was checked and found to have NO row for the claimed product/date - used for the one entry documenting a deleted, fabricated product.

entries.notes: DELETED-PRODUCT REGRESSION ENTRY. A prior (pre-recertification) pass authored a product data/releases/products/yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters-national-tournament-prize-cards.json claiming a physical ocg-jp release on 1999-02-21 of three cards: Millennium Shield, Megasonic Eye, Yamadron. Konami's official product catalogue has NO row for any such product - confirmed both by this fixture's full-page scan and, separately, by each of those three cards' own individual Konami card-level print-history (checked directly: none records any printing earlier than 1999-06-01). The claim traced to a misread Yugipedia table: 'National Tournament prize cards' lists results by placement tier in two columns, 'Physical card' and 'Video game card'; the Qualifying tier's Physical-card cell is BLANK, and its Video-game-card cell (Kanan the Swordmistress, Millennium Shield, Megasonic Eye, Yamadron) links to Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters (Game Boy, 1998-12-16, itself Non-OCG) hidden-card unlock pages using a distinct {{DM1 card}} template with no passcode field. Kanan alone is ALSO physically real, but via the wholly separate, correctly-sourced yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters-national-tournament-attendance-card product. The fabricated product has been deleted; Millennium Shield/Megasonic Eye/Yamadron remain correctly in the certified pool via their genuine 1999-06-01 Limited Edition pack release (see the three limited-edition-*-pack entries below), so this correction changes zero pool membership. This entry exists so a future regression - re-adding a 1999-02-21 physical product for these three cards - has something concrete to be checked against and fail.

regression_guard.note: These 3 cards' genuine earliest ocg-jp availability is 1999-06-01 (Limited Edition packs). Any product dating them EARLIER than 1999-06-01 reintroduces the fabricated-release defect this entry documents.
